about: Venues whose own websites Soundcheck may read. An entry is added only after the venue passed the compliance gate (own data, robots.txt allows, terms do not forbid); reading it also needs its key in soundcheck.ingestion.venues.sites. Coordinates: postcodes.io for the postcode (2025-06-05). ticketmasterVenueId pins the venue to the one Ticketmaster created.

venues.notes: Public keyless JSON API documented at /developers/; robots.txt invites API use.
The Events Calendar REST API; times labelled UTC+0 are London wall-clock times; titles are sentences.
